data_infos.source_type: 新北市資料開放平臺 data.ntpc.gov.tw
data_infos.etl_description: Fetch the data.ntpc JSON API page by page with a browser User-Agent. Normalize percentN aliases by role, keep the all-age male/female totals in a separate indicator from age detail, parse age intervals strictly, and keep 年齡不詳 as null bounds with its raw label. Reconcile every source cell and assert that each year's age-detail sum equals the source male/female total. A threefold year-scale guard compares each yearly total with the median of the other years and raises on an unknown scope change. The source is a count, not a rate; no population scaling is applied. Youth conversion is apportioned because 30-39 crosses age 35.
